references.text: Psalm 1:1-2 speaks of the blessing of not sitting in the seat of scoffers, which can be seen in contrast to Jesus' willingness to eat with sinners and tax collectors in Matthew 9:10.
Luke 5:29-32 describes a similar event where Levi holds a great feast for Jesus, and tax collectors and sinners were present, mirroring the event in Matthew 9:10.
Mark 2:15-17 also tells of Jesus eating with tax collectors and sinners, which directly corresponds to the event in Matthew 9:10.
Isaiah 53:12 prophesies that the Messiah will be counted among transgressors, which is reflected in Jesus' actions in Matthew 9:10.
